items.title: FlashML-org / FreeToken
items.summary: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts serving engine that runs 290B+ frontier open-weight models on consumer hardware like gaming PCs. It unifies heterogeneous resources such as GPUs, CPUs, and host memory into an elastic inference platform with bandwidth-adaptive co-execution.
items.why_it_matters: It enables local execution of large models on existing personal hardware, supporting integration with coding and tool-calling agents via Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
items.next_step_detail: git clone https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken && follow the README to serve a 7B model locally.

items.title: Your AI Agent Trusts Everything It Reads — A Field Guide to Hijacking Claude, GPT, Gemini & Copilot
items.summary: Indirect prompt injection allows attackers to plant instructions in untrusted content, such as files or emails, which agents then execute to expose private data or trigger unauthorized actions. This risk arises when an agent simultaneously has access to private data, untrusted content, and an outbound channel for data exfiltration.
items.why_it_matters: The model's internal structure is not a dependable security boundary, requiring applications to enforce authority and action limits externally to prevent data theft or unwanted actions.
items.next_step_detail: Review the mitigation checklist and apply input‑validation patches to your agent pipelines.

items.title: ifixai-ai / iFixAi
items.summary: iFixAi is an independent auditor that places AI agents in a business simulation to test their responses against real-world requests, including those that push beyond their defined roles. It uses a judge from a different provider to grade every reply, providing a pass or fail for each inspection along with evidence.
items.why_it_matters: It verifies that an agent respects organizational intentions, goals, and authorization boundaries, ensuring it does not perform unauthorized actions or violate policies before deployment.
items.next_step_detail: Clone the repo and run the sample audit on one of your existing agent scripts.

items.title: scenario-labs / skills
items.summary: Scenario Agent Skills are a set of instructions for AI coding agents to generate production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D assets via the Scenario MCP server. The skills also include expert tools that drive local DCC software and game engines like Blender and Unreal Engine.
items.why_it_matters: The skills provide a standardized method for agents to create multi-modal content and operate specific creative software, with installation options for both MCP-based generation and local application control.
items.next_step_detail: Compare Scenario Skills against existing asset generation stacks like RunwayML or Stability AI pipelines.

items.title: I hid instructions in my server logs to see which models would follow them

items.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a realistic attack surface that can affect any production LLM service.

items.title: Wraith: a ghost in my zsh that stops your hand before the dangerous command runs
